description.value: Wings Port Moody is a location of the WINGS Restaurants chain, known for award-winning wings offered in 28 globally inspired flavours. It is a full-service restaurant and bar on St. Johns Street serving wings, burgers, pizza, pasta, and salads. Note that it is a liquor-primary establishment, so minors under 19 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

address.value: 2414 St. Johns St., Port Moody, BC
